-- =============================================================================
-- CONSOLIDATED BIGQUERY SQL: CV_COMP_FIN_SBT
-- Final Consumer: CV_COMP_FIN_SBT (Composite Calculation View - CUBE/Aggregation)
-- Generated by: BigQuery SQL Consolidation Agent
-- Runtime Parameters:
--   @ip_week_ending_from  STRING  -- Fiscal week start (from SFN_PRIOR_FISCAL_WEEK, unresolved scalar function)
--   @ip_week_ending_to    STRING  -- Fiscal week end   (from SFN_PRIOR_FISCAL_WEEK, unresolved scalar function)
-- =============================================================================

WITH

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: BKPF
-- Logic: Projects and filters accounting document header records from
--        the BigQuery source table v_bkpf (mapped from HANA BKPF/BKPF_VT_S4).
--        Applies the CV_BASE_FIN_BKPF_S4 client filter (mandt IN ('120','200'))
--        and the CV_COMP_FIN_SBT document-type and reference filters
--        (xref2_hd = 'A1', blart = 'ZT').
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bkpf
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120', '200'); xref2_hd = 'A1'; blart = 'ZT'
-- =====================================================================
BKPF AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    bukrs,
    belnr,
    gjahr,
    xref2_hd,
    budat,
    blart
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bkpf`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
    AND xref2_hd = 'A1'
    AND blart = 'ZT'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: ACDOCA
-- Logic: Projects and filters universal journal entry line items from
--        the BigQuery source table v_acdoca (mapped from HANA ACDOCA_VT_S4).
--        Applies the CV_BASE_FIN_ACDOCA_S4 client filter (rclnt IN ('120','200'))
--        and the CV_COMP_FIN_SBT profit-center, GL-account, and fiscal-week
--        filters (prctr IN (...), racct = '0004403000',
--        zzweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to).
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_acdoca
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120', '200');
--          prctr IN ('0000562057', '0000562058');
--          racct = '0004403000';
--          zzweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
-- =====================================================================
ACDOCA AS (
  SELECT
    rclnt,
    rbukrs,
    belnr,
    gjahr,
    wsl,
    prctr,
    racct,
    zzweek,
    rwcur
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_acdoca`
  WHERE rclnt IN ('120', '200')
    AND prctr IN ('0000562057', '0000562058')
    AND racct = '0004403000'
    AND zzweek BETWEEN @ip_week_ending_from AND @ip_week_ending_to
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: SBT
-- Logic: Joins filtered BKPF and ACDOCA records (INNER JOIN) on company
--        code, document number, and fiscal year to produce the core
--        financial transaction dataset (SBT node in CV_COMP_FIN_SBT).
-- Source: BKPF (CTE 1), ACDOCA (CTE 2)
-- Join: INNER JOIN BKPF ON BKPF.bukrs = ACDOCA.rbukrs
--                       AND BKPF.belnr = ACDOCA.belnr
--                       AND BKPF.gjahr = ACDOCA.gjahr
-- =====================================================================
SBT AS (
  SELECT
    BKPF.mandt,
    BKPF.bukrs,
    BKPF.belnr,
    BKPF.gjahr,
    BKPF.xref2_hd,
    BKPF.budat,
    ACDOCA.wsl,
    ACDOCA.prctr,
    ACDOCA.racct,
    ACDOCA.zzweek,
    ACDOCA.rwcur
  FROM BKPF
  INNER JOIN ACDOCA
    ON BKPF.bukrs  = ACDOCA.rbukrs
   AND BKPF.belnr  = ACDOCA.belnr
   AND BKPF.gjahr  = ACDOCA.gjahr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: STORE_ATTRIBUTES
-- Logic: Projects store profile attribute records from the BigQuery
--        source table v_ztsrp_attr_act (mapped from HANA ZTSRP_ATTR_ACT),
--        applying the CV_BASE_MD_SRPACT_S4 client filter
--        (mandt IN ('120','200')).  Only the columns consumed by
--        CV_COMP_FIN_SBT are projected.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120', '200')
-- =====================================================================
STORE_ATTRIBUTES AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    city,
    state,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: Join_1
-- Logic: Left-outer-joins the SBT transaction dataset with store profile
--        attributes on profit center (prctr), enriching each transaction
--        with store/market hierarchy attributes.
-- Source: SBT (CTE 3), STORE_ATTRIBUTES (CTE 4)
-- Join: LEFT OUTER JOIN STORE_ATTRIBUTES ON SBT.prctr = STORE_ATTRIBUTES.prctr
-- =====================================================================
Join_1 AS (
  SELECT
    SBT.mandt,
    SBT.bukrs,
    SBT.belnr,
    SBT.gjahr,
    SBT.xref2_hd,
    SBT.budat,
    SBT.prctr,
    SBT.wsl,
    SBT.zzweek,
    SBT.rwcur,
    SA.rep_mkt_code,
    SA.rep_mkt_desc,
    SA.city,
    SA.state,
    SA.division_code,
    SA.division_desc,
    SA.area_code,
    SA.area_desc,
    SA.region_code,
    SA.region_desc,
    SA.district_code,
    SA.district_desc,
    SA.strnum,
    SA.fs_open_dat,
    SA.rx_open_dat,
    SA.emerg_mkt_ind,
    SA.rx_division_code,
    SA.rx_area_code,
    SA.rx_region_code,
    SA.rx_district_code
  FROM SBT
  LEFT OUTER JOIN STORE_ATTRIBUTES AS SA
    ON SBT.prctr = SA.prctr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: RETAIL_CALENAR
-- Logic: Projects retail calendar week records from the BigQuery source
--        table v_ztfigl_rcalweek (mapped from HANA ZTFIGL_RCALWEEK),
--        applying the CV_BASE_MD_RCALWEEK_S4 client filter
--        (rclnt IN ('120','200')).  Only columns consumed by
--        CV_COMP_FIN_SBT are projected.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120', '200')
-- =====================================================================
RETAIL_CALENAR AS (
  SELECT
    zzweek,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    rclnt
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
  WHERE rclnt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: Join_2
-- Logic: Left-outer-joins the enriched transaction dataset (Join_1) with
--        the retail calendar on fiscal week (zzweek), adding week start
--        and end dates.
-- Source: Join_1 (CTE 5), RETAIL_CALENAR (CTE 6)
-- Join: LEFT OUTER JOIN RETAIL_CALENAR ON Join_1.zzweek = RETAIL_CALENAR.zzweek
-- =====================================================================
Join_2 AS (
  SELECT
    J1.mandt,
    J1.bukrs,
    J1.belnr,
    J1.gjahr,
    J1.xref2_hd,
    J1.budat,
    J1.prctr,
    J1.wsl,
    J1.zzweek,
    J1.rwcur,
    J1.rep_mkt_code,
    J1.rep_mkt_desc,
    J1.city,
    J1.state,
    J1.division_code,
    J1.division_desc,
    J1.area_code,
    J1.area_desc,
    J1.region_code,
    J1.region_desc,
    J1.district_code,
    J1.district_desc,
    J1.strnum,
    J1.fs_open_dat,
    J1.rx_open_dat,
    J1.emerg_mkt_ind,
    J1.rx_division_code,
    J1.rx_area_code,
    J1.rx_region_code,
    J1.rx_district_code,
    RC.zrwenddate,
    RC.zrwstrtdate
  FROM Join_1 AS J1
  LEFT OUTER JOIN RETAIL_CALENAR AS RC
    ON J1.zzweek = RC.zzweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: COMP_FLAG
-- Logic: Adds two calculated columns to the joined dataset:
--        cal_comp_flag: '1' when prctr = '0000562057', else '0'
--        cal_week_number: last 2 characters of the zzweek string
--        (zzweek is STRING per Columns_Mapping; no CAST required).
-- Source: Join_2 (CTE 7)
-- Calculation:
--   cal_comp_flag    = CASE WHEN prctr = '0000562057' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
--   cal_week_number  = RIGHT(zzweek, 2)
-- =====================================================================
COMP_FLAG AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    bukrs,
    belnr,
    gjahr,
    xref2_hd,
    budat,
    prctr,
    wsl,
    zzweek,
    rwcur,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    city,
    state,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    strnum,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    CASE WHEN prctr = '0000562057' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS cal_comp_flag,
    RIGHT(zzweek, 2)                                      AS cal_week_number
  FROM Join_2
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Logic: Projects profit center text records from the BigQuery source
--        table v_cepct (mapped from HANA CEPCT), applying the
--        CV_BASE_MD_CEPCT_S4 client filter (mandt IN ('120','200')).
--        Maps HANA column LTEXT to the output alias profit_center_text
--        as required by CV_COMP_FIN_SBT.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120', '200')
-- =====================================================================
PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    ltext AS profit_center_text
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
  WHERE mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 10: Join_3
-- Logic: Left-outer-joins the COMP_FLAG dataset with profit center texts
--        on profit center (prctr), adding the profit_center_text
--        descriptor.  This is the final pre-aggregation dataset and
--        matches the Join_3 node in CV_COMP_FIN_SBT.
-- Source: COMP_FLAG (CTE 8), PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT (CTE 9)
-- Join: LEFT OUTER JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT ON COMP_FLAG.prctr = PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT.prctr
-- =====================================================================
Join_3 AS (
  SELECT
    CF.prctr,
    CF.budat,
    CF.xref2_hd,
    CF.gjahr,
    CF.belnr,
    CF.bukrs,
    CF.mandt,
    CF.rep_mkt_code,
    CF.rep_mkt_desc,
    CF.city,
    CF.state,
    CF.division_code,
    CF.division_desc,
    CF.area_code,
    CF.area_desc,
    CF.region_code,
    CF.region_desc,
    CF.district_code,
    CF.district_desc,
    CF.zzweek,
    CF.strnum,
    CF.cal_comp_flag,
    CF.cal_week_number,
    CF.zrwenddate,
    CF.zrwstrtdate,
    CF.rwcur,
    CF.wsl,
    PCT.profit_center_text,
    CF.fs_open_dat,
    CF.rx_open_dat,
    CF.emerg_mkt_ind,
    CF.rx_division_code,
    CF.rx_area_code,
    CF.rx_region_code,
    CF.rx_district_code
  FROM COMP_FLAG AS CF
  LEFT OUTER JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS PCT
    ON CF.prctr = PCT.prctr
)

-- =====================================================================
-- Final SELECT
-- Logic: Aggregates the fully joined dataset as required by
--        CV_COMP_FIN_SBT (dataCategory="CUBE", outputViewType="Aggregation").
--        wsl_negative = SUM(wsl)  -- intermediate aggregated measure
--        wsl          = SUM(wsl) * -1  -- final calculated measure
--        All non-measure output columns are included in GROUP BY.
-- Source: Join_3 (CTE 10)
-- Aggregation: SUM(wsl) AS wsl_negative; SUM(wsl) * -1 AS wsl
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  prctr,
  budat,
  xref2_hd,
  gjahr,
  belnr,
  bukrs,
  mandt,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  city,
  state,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  region_code,
  region_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  zzweek,
  strnum,
  cal_comp_flag,
  cal_week_number,
  zrwenddate,
  zrwstrtdate,
  rwcur,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code,
  SUM(wsl)        AS wsl_negative,
  SUM(wsl) * -1   AS wsl
FROM Join_3
GROUP BY
  prctr,
  budat,
  xref2_hd,
  gjahr,
  belnr,
  bukrs,
  mandt,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  city,
  state,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  region_code,
  region_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  zzweek,
  strnum,
  cal_comp_flag,
  cal_week_number,
  zrwenddate,
  zrwstrtdate,
  rwcur,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code
